name: videoFrame
description: Extract a single frame from a video file at a specific timestamp. Returns the path to the extracted frame image.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Timestamp to extract (e.g., 00:01:30 for 1 minute 30 seconds, or 1.5 for 1.5 seconds)

parameters.name: outputName
parameters.description: Output filename without extension. Default frame.
